fields.kicker: // SOFTWARE ENGINEERING STUDENT — CEBU CITY, PH

fields.text: BS Information Technology, 3rd Year at Cebu Institute of Technology – University. National DOST Scholar building software and leading creative direction.
Driven by obsessive craft and creative curiosity — engineering software that feels as deliberate, fluid, and refined to touch as it is structurally sound.

Third-year BS Information Technology student at Cebu Institute of Technology – University and a National DOST Scholar, with a strong foundation in software development and creative production. Outside the classroom, that same instinct carries into how he leads: as Chief Creatives Officer for GDGoC CIT-U, he treats a layout or a publication with the same care as a piece of code — deliberate, consistent, and built to be understood at a glance. He's most engaged where logic meets aesthetics — building a working feature one day, refining a visual system the next — and that range shows up across hackathons, game jams, and campus developer communities he's contributed to.

fields.lead: Engineering systems, Android architectures, and interactive experiments built with modularity and tactile feedback.

fields.name: SariSmart
fields.lead: Offline-first Android inventory management app for sari-sari stores, built with an MVP architecture.
body: An offline-first Android inventory management application designed specifically for neighborhood sari-sari micro-retail stores. Built using Kotlin with clean Model-View-Presenter (MVP) architecture.

Features full offline synchronization, secure local SQLite persistence, real-time inventory level tracking, stock alerting, daily sales analytics, and transaction recording without requiring an active internet connection.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Strict offline-first persistence with defensive SQLite caching, decoupled MVP contracts, and asynchronous background sync guaranteeing zero data loss during connectivity drops.

fields.name: Online Marketplace
fields.lead: Modern commerce prototype with dynamic cataloging, cart state management, and authenticated checkout.
body: Comprehensive digital marketplace prototype built for seamless item exploration, category filtering, cart management, and order processing.
Focuses on ultra-low latency navigation, responsive layouts across devices, and scalable API integration patterns.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Optimized client-side state machine for real-time inventory updates and responsive micro-interactions across varied viewport constraints.

fields.name: Silentium
fields.lead: Minimalist atmospheric soundscapes and distraction-free workspace environment for focused work.
body: A bespoke ambient focus application delivering generative audio environments with spatial panning and volume balancing.
Explores neo-brutalist UI paradigms with subtle reactive micro-interactions and low cognitive overhead.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Modular Web Audio synthesizer nodes running off the main thread with spatial stereo separation for natural binaural sound.

fields.name: Color Sequence Game
fields.lead: Pattern memorization and reactive sequencing game exploring timing, score states, and sound cues.
body: High-speed reactive pattern recall game engineered in vanilla JavaScript with procedural audio feedback.
Implemented custom state machines for difficulty ramp-up, input queuing, and local high-score persistence.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Deterministic state machine with requestAnimationFrame tick timing and strict queue synchronization to prevent input collisions.

fields.name: Hamsteremoji
fields.lead: Interactive vector emoji creator and asset generator for digital communities.
body: Custom vector emoji styling engine allowing users to assemble, preview, and export layered vector art assets in real-time.
Demonstrates component-based rendering and instant SVG/PNG rasterization pipelines.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Layered vector compositing pipeline with high-resolution canvas exporting and SVG node mutation optimization.

fields.name: React Component & Props
fields.lead: Modular design system library emphasizing polymorphic components, strict typing, and a11y standards.
body: A clean component architecture showcase implementing compound component patterns, keyboard accessibility, and tokenized design systems.
Provides reusable primitives for high-performance dashboard interfaces.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Strict polymorphism with generic TypeScript props and full ARIA adherence across complex compound components.

fields.name: ExpressJS Backend Suite
fields.lead: Robust RESTful microservices engine featuring JWT authorization, rate limiting, and database abstraction.
body: Scalable backend boilerplate with layered routing, request sanitization, role-based access control, and transactional DB pooling.
Built with test-driven methodologies and automated endpoint documentation.

takeaway.title: // KEY TAKEAWAY & ARCHITECTURE
takeaway.body: Layered architecture separating controllers, services, and repositories with connection pool reuse and centralized middleware error handling.

fields.title: 1st Naga City Mayoral Hackathon
body: Semifinalist in the prestigious Hospital/Health Service Track under a civic innovation initiative launched by Mayor Leni Robredo.

As part of the 5-member Team Techalang, conceptualized and engineered a rapid-response digital prototype addressing critical bottlenecks in urban hospital triage, patient queuing, and medical service dispatch.
Contributed to system design, interface mockups, and client-side application state management within an intensive 48-hour development sprint.

fields.title: NEXT LEVEL: Esports Game Dev Challenge
fields.meta: Top 6–10 Regional Finalist · Team Clutch Five · DOST Region VII
body: Selected as a Top 6–10 Regional Finalist in the esports game development competition hosted by the Department of Science and Technology (DOST) Region VII.
Collaborated within Team Clutch Five to design and implement a competitive game prototype meeting rigorous technical and performance benchmarks.
Responsible for gameplay physics tuning, player input handling, and responsive audiovisual cues.

fields.title: DOST Game Dev Challenge at ICon — Pinoy Party
fields.meta: 4-Player Multiplayer · Team Clutch Five · ICon Convention
body: Official Exhibitor and Finalist at the DOST ICon Game Development Showcase featuring the flagship title "Pinoy Party".
Co-developed a 4-player couch/online multiplayer digital board game proudly inspired by traditional Filipino folk games (Laro ng Lahi).
Programmed core turn-based board mechanics, dynamic trivia and interactive challenge systems, synchronized minigames, and animated player assets.

fields.title: CodeChum C Programming Certification
body: Ranked Top 1 overall in the CodeChum C Programming Certification evaluation, demonstrating mastery of low-level memory management, pointers, complex data structures, and algorithmic optimization.

fields.title: CodeChum Java Programming Certification
body: Earned official certification in Java Programming, demonstrating practical command of OOP principles, abstraction, polymorphic interfaces, exceptions, and collection frameworks.

fields.title: DOST-SEI Merit Scholarship Award
fields.meta: Department of Science and Technology · Republic of the Philippines
body: Conferred the prestigious Department of Science and Technology (DOST) Science Education Institute Merit Scholarship, awarded to students demonstrating superior aptitude in STEM and software disciplines.
